hints.back: Returns to the screen that opened the assistant.
hints.review: Opens the informational, privacy, and emergency notices.
hints.send: Sends the current message for offline assessment.
hints.changePet: Selects another pet. An existing conversation requires confirmation.
hints.reset: Clears messages after confirmation while retaining consent and the selected pet.

consent.title: Before you continue
consent.information: This assistant provides general information only. It cannot diagnose your pet or replace a veterinarian.

privacy.encrypted: Your current conversation is stored securely on this device until you reset it or sign out.
privacy.session: This conversation is available only during this session. It is not saved, so it will not be restored after you leave or sign out.
privacy.unavailable: This conversation is kept in memory only for now and may not be restored. Your consent is still saved securely.

consent.emergency: For an emergency, contact the nearest emergency veterinary service immediately. Do not wait for this assistant.

pets.title: Who are we caring for?
pets.subtitle: Choose a pet so the assistant can tailor every answer to their profile.
pets.errorTitle: Your pets are out of reach
pets.error: We could not load your pets.
pets.empty: Create a pet profile before starting a conversation.
pets.footnote: Each conversation stays focused on one pet so guidance remains clear and relevant.
pets.confirmChange: Changing pets starts a new conversation. Continue?

conversation.confirmReset: Clear this conversation? Your consent and selected pet will remain.
conversation.confirmChangePet: Change to {{name}}? This clears the current conversation. Your consent will remain.
conversation.disclaimer: General guidance only — not a diagnosis.

empty.title: How can I help with {{name}}?
empty.body: Ask about everyday care, nutrition, behavior, routines, or a health concern.

assessment.possibleConditionNote: A possibility to raise with a veterinarian — not a diagnosis.

emergency.title: Emergency action needed
emergency.body: Contact the nearest emergency veterinary service immediately. Do not wait for another assistant response.
emergency.detected: Your message may describe an emergency.
emergency.findVetHint: Opens maps or search for nearby emergency veterinary care.
emergency.findVetFailed: We couldn't open maps here. Search for the nearest emergency veterinary clinic and contact them directly.

errors.requestTitle: That answer did not come through
errors.request: We could not prepare guidance. Your message is saved.
errors.persistence: This conversation may not be restored next time.

disclaimer.short: General information only—not a diagnosis or substitute for veterinary care.

accessibility.emergencyActionUnavailable: Could not open emergency care search. Emergency instructions remain on screen.
accessibility.responsePending: Sending your message. The assistant is responding.
accessibility.requestFailed: The assistant could not answer. You can retry.
